files.startup.S:
.section .text.start,"ax",@progbits
    .globl _start
    .type _start,@function
    .option norvc
    .option norelax
_start:
    la sp, __stack_top
    la t0, __bss_start
    la t1, __bss_end
1:
    bgeu t0, t1, 2f
    sw zero, 0(t0)
    addi t0, t0, 4
    j 1b
2:
    call main
3:
    j 3b
    .size _start, .-_start
